title: State Government Notification in Official Gazette

content.scenario: The State Government of Maharashtra wants to establish a regional bench of the State Commission in the city of Pune. It must notify this decision in the Official Gazette after consulting with the State Commission.
content.outcome: The State Government of Maharashtra will notify the establishment of the regional bench in the Official Gazette, as required by law, after consulting with the State Commission. This notification will be made ordinarily at the State capital, Mumbai.

user_queries: What is the procedure for establishing a regional bench of the State Commission?
How does the State Government notify the establishment of a regional bench?
What is the role of the State Commission in the notification process?
